crossRefs.note: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore…
They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold…
You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away…
But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to…
However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

translations.web: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”
translations.bsb: Can man make gods for himself? Such are not gods!”
translations.kjv: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
translations.asv: Shall a man make unto himself gods, which yet are no gods?
